profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am an experienced Software Engineer seeking to further my knowledge in those respective fields. My aim is to always deliver the best possible solutions to my customers needs. I have significant experience in object oriented programming and software design/structure. I have several years of java and C# programming experience as a full stack developer with GUI development experience in Swing, SWT, JFace, and Windows Forms. I also have experience with Eclipse RCP development and the OSGi framework. My background also being in Mechanical Engineering, I have mostly developed applications focused on engineering analysis in various fields of study.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Summary: Worked as a full stack software developer on DOD High Performance Computing conceptual aircraft design tool creating its Plugin Framework, Air Vehicle Modeling Framework, and Trade Space Execution architecture.
o	Developed a plugin extensibility architecture utilizing the Managed Extensibility Framework (MEF) allowing the application functionality to be extended by user developed plugins used for aero analysis of an air vehicle 
o	Utilized the C# task based asynchronous pattern to create a multithreaded asynchronous execution engine utilizing a configurable linked list of execution units for air vehicle analysis
o	Created a flexible and extensible modeling framework utilizing a  façade pattern for users to interact with that smartly decouples users from implementation details allowing users to interact with a stable API for interacting with the air vehicle model
o	Developed integration and unit testing using visual studio MSTest Framework for plugin architecture, modeling framework, and aero surface air vehicle components
Summary: Worked as a full stack software developer on DOD High Performance Computing Genesis Design conceptual air vehicle design tool, focusing on modularity and robust well tested OSGi bundles and a new geometry architecture API
o	Utilized BndTools/OSGi framework for backend development and modularization of the software, testing using standard Junit and Apache Felix Framework for bundle testing
o	Created robust tested geometry architecture accessed through JavaScript for use in constructive solid modeling for air vehicle geometries
o	Developed core OpenSEA architecture and developed a bundle framework for importing user made bundles that extend program capabilities
o	Developed Geometry Viewer utilizing OpenGL and JOGL libraries

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked, under the agile scrum process,  to develop the core systems engineering software architecture, a directed acyclic graph, of DaVinci program; utilized for physics based modeling of aerospace models and characterization and analysis of model cost, performance, and efficiency
•	Developed and designed critical core classes used in setting up the graph and calculation of complex user scripts used in aircraft analysis in the backend
•	Developed/Utilized DaVinci parametric aircraft models with design of experiments to run a suite of aircraft sizing models to fit mission parameters such as range, take off gross weight, and velocity to determine conceptual aircraft designs that would work within the constraints given by customers. 
•	Utilized SWT widget tool kit and Eclipse RCP to develop GUI elements in the frontend  
•	Developed and executed tests scripts utilizing Junit and Mokito
•	Created an Monte Carlo Simulation framework for use in trade space exploration of concept aircraft
•	Utilized Eclipse RCP and BndTools/OSGi framework
•	Coordinated between software engineers and aerospace engineers to gather functional requirements for potential users  of the program to insure development of software remained in line with requirements
•	Developed api for statistical analysis program DEDS (previously developed in my previous position) to be utilized by DaVinci software for requesting statistic jobs to do trade space studies on aircraft and quantify uncertainties, and sensitivities of various aircraft performance parameters

positions.title: Junior Aerospace Modeling Engineer
positions.description:
--Lead the development of a statistical analysis suite for use in USAF Create-AV program, DaVinci
--Utilized Java programming and Eclipse IDE to develop the statistical analysis tool
--Developed the program to perform Full Factorial, Fractional Factorial and Latin Hypercube experimental Designs
--Developed the program to be able to accomplish ANOVAs, Least Squares regressions, stepwise regression, and plotting capabilities including response surfaces
--Engineered and designed the UI for the program
--Utilized the developed software and Systems Engineering approach to do optimization studies on aircraft models and modify the designs of the models to increase performance of the aircraft
--Additionally worked with software developers on core aspects of DaVinci's directed acyclic graph for efficient calculations

positions.title: Biomedical Instrument design
positions.description:
*Improved system design of ConMed’s Bend-A-Beam argon beam coagulation device through several changes to the
distal geometry of the probes
* Designed an injection mold piece; maintained stable flow of argon gas while maintaining necessary thermal
parameters and strong needle centering and stability
* Developed initial concept schematics, conducted fluid dynamics and heat transfer analysis, constructed CAD designs,
completed statistical analysis, and finalized technical reports
* Completed CAD designs utilizing Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing and completed high level statistical
analysis of prototypes using 2 and 3 factor ANOVA’s
* Enhanced the manufacturability of the probes and needle stability; performance of redesigns were gauged to be highly
repeatable and reliable

projects.title: DEDS - Statistical Analysis Tool
projects.description: Develop statistical analysis tool similar to JMP using Java. The tool, DEDS, consists of data table, Scatter plot matrix, contour plot, and various 3-D and 2-D plot to display data. The data table functions similar to Excel in many ways. DEDS also included several regression methods, such as step-wise and linear. DEDS was to be able to send and receive data from a CAD-like program named DaVinci.
